summary: iter-94 (Jan 2026) backend regression for the four owner-asked Slangcart enhancements — all 16 pytest cases PASS against the preview backend. Verified: (1) GET /api/recharge/history returns network_name, network_logo, can_repeat, current_price, price_changed and highlights{data,validity,calls}; auth-required (401 anon), per-user (rider sees none of the buyer's rows), can_repeat flips to false and current_price→null when the plan is unpublished, and price_changed becomes true after admin PATCHes the plan price. (2) Repeat flow — POST /api/recharge/payment/start with ONLY {kind, product_id, account} picks state/network from the plan's own tags (asserted network='airtel', state='andhra-pradesh-telangana-ap-tg'), then /verify with a pay_MOCK_* token books a brand-new recharges row + 'recharge' transaction, and a replayed verify returns already_verified with the SAME recharge_id (no double-book). (3) plan_highlights() derivation — seeded Airtel 'Unlimited 28 days · 2GB/day' → data=2GB/day, validity=28 days, calls=Unlimited calls; 'Data add-on · 1GB' → data=1GB only (validity+calls blank); 'Talktime ₹100' → calls=Full talktime (data+validity blank). A plan created with EXPLICIT recharge_data/validity/calls wins over parsing on BOTH /api/recharge/products and GET /api/products/{id}. A plucked non-recharge product does NOT carry a highlights key. (4) PATCH /api/admin/recharge/options/{id} — image_url (data URI) + name (slug re-derived to 'airtel') + sort_order persisted; the logo appears both on GET /recharge/options AND the mirrored Recharge → Mobile Recharge → Airtel row of GET /shop-categories/tree; image_url:'' clears to null; vendor+buyer tokens get 403; unknown id gets 404. (5) GET /api/delivery-partner/me/customers with lat/lng → distance_km populated, items nearest-first, sorted_by='distance', has_origin=true; sort=orders flips sorted_by to 'orders'; omitting lat/lng falls back to the rider's dp_pincodes centroid (has_origin still true, distance_km still populated). (6) Shipping-address identity — name/phone/address/pincode come from order.shipping_address (asserted non-empty for the seeded Test Buyer order), and per-shop grouping (shops[], order_count, cash_to_collect) is intact. (7) Regression — POST /customers/{uid}/advance still responds 200/400 (never 5xx) on both first and replayed calls.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/order_payments.py (ln 254-255): start uses `plan.get('recharge_state') / plan.get('recharge_network')` as the fallback for the Repeat path, which is exactly why the owner was able to send ONLY {kind, product_id, account} — verified by test_repeat_books_second_recharge_and_is_idempotent.
routes/order_payments.py (ln 338-352): the status='created' guarded update is the real idempotency lever — a replay finds no row to flip and returns the stored recharge_id. Verified.

routes/order_payments.py (ln 391-430): recharge_history enriches each row with the LIVE plan snapshot (price, active, is_published) at response time rather than snapshotting at purchase; this is why can_repeat/current_price/price_changed stay honest after an admin edit. The abs(..)>0.009 tolerance is the right lever to avoid float-noise false positives.

routes/recharge.py (ln 229-266 plan_highlights): explicit vendor fields are preferred BEFORE the regex pass (`if not data:` etc.) so admin overrides win without disabling the parser for the rest of the catalogue. The regex uses `(/\s*day|per day|a day)?` so '2GB/day' AND '2GB per day' render identically. Good.

routes/recharge.py (ln 384-417 update_option): slug is re-derived only when `name` is non-empty, image_url:'' is normalised to None, and sync_shop_categories() runs after every PATCH — exactly why the Airtel tile's logo shows up on /shop-categories/tree without a separate resync call. The default role gate is `super_admin, products_manager` — buyers+vendors are blocked (403) as expected.

routes/delivery_partner.py (ln 660-682): identity now reads addr.name/phone/line1-2/city/pincode from order.shipping_address and only falls back to the user row when the order didn't carry one — this is the exact fix the owner called out ('previously read from non-existent order fields and came back blank'). Verified non-empty for the Test Buyer order.

routes/delivery_partner.py (ln 710-721): the origin fallback chain is explicit→user.lat/lng→pincode_centroid(dp_pincodes[0]) — guaranteeing has_origin=true for any rider with EITHER coords or a pincode mapping, which is the common case.

routes/delivery_partner.py (ln 748-756): the toggle uses `sort != 'orders' AND any(distance_km is not None)` so a rider with no resolvable location STILL gets a sensible order (most-orders-first) even when he passes sort=distance by accident.

seed_data_creation: The suite creates recharge plans named 'ITER94 Pay Plan …' and 'ITER94 Repeat …' and deletes them via DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} in a module-scoped teardown. However, each buy flow leaves behind a `recharges` row AND a `recharge_payments` row AND a `transactions` row for testbuyer@test.com — same situation iter-93 reported, there is still no admin recharge-delete endpoint, so 4 can_repeat=false 'ITER94 …' rows now sit at the top of testbuyer's history (plan docs deleted, hence can_repeat=false and current_price=null — they are harmless but visually noisy). The Airtel logo is explicitly cleared back to empty by test_clear_logo_with_empty_string, so operator rows end the run byte-identical to the starting state. No vendor mapping changes; no money moved outside the Razorpay mock path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The backend URL in frontend/.env is `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL — that key is absent). Login response field is `token` (not access_token). The edge returns 403 for non-browser UAs — send `User-Agent: curl/8.5.0`. `GET /api/products` lists are pincode-gated and often empty for anonymous callers; walk `GET /api/admin/products?limit=100&page={n}` instead. `GET /api/recharge/options?kind=mobile` returns `{mobile:{states,networks}, dth:{...}, types:[...]}` (NOT a flat `items` list). The `AP+TG` state slug is `andhra-pradesh-telangana-ap-tg`. The seeded Airtel plan ids live under `rchg-mobile-andhra-pradesh-telangana-ap-tg-airtel-…`. The rider a0bf6822-… is mapped to Vendor Two Store and his dp_pincodes=['517644']; he has one customer (Test Buyer, 21 open orders, cash_to_collect ≈ ₹3649) within 0.4 km of (13.7484, 79.7027). ITER94 recharge rows will accumulate every run until main agent adds `DELETE /api/admin/recharges/{id}` or similar — not blocking any iter-94 behaviour.
